name: roll erector spinae lying on floor
description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the lower back muscles. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under your lower back.
Place the roller under the lower back muscles and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly with small movements and keep your core engaged.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
